# Chem AI: Chemistry Solver

> Chem AI is an iPhone chemistry learning assistant that scans homework questions and explains solutions step by step.

## Official pages

- Website: https://chem-ai-solver.woodsy-bison-3513.chatgpt.site/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/chem-ai-chemistry-solver/id6739063555
- Privacy policy: https://kksoftservice.github.io/chemistry_ai/en/policy.html
- Terms of use: https://kksoftservice.github.io/chemistry_ai/en/support.html

## Core capabilities

- Scan a chemistry question from a photo.
- Answer typed chemistry questions with step-by-step explanations.
- Explore an interactive periodic table.
- Draw chemical structures using SMILES notation.
- Calculate molar mass from a chemical formula.

## Product facts

- Platform: iPhone
- Compatibility: iOS 13.0 or later
- Category: Education
- Availability: Free download with optional in-app purchases
- Languages: English and 17 additional languages
